title: Outlook Signature Won't Save? Fix It in 3 Minutes
excerpt: Corrupt NormalEmail.dotm, roaming profiles, and the one registry fix that sticks.
symptoms: ['Signature disappears after restart','Images missing in signature','Mobile signature different from desktop']
steps: [{'heading': '1. Delete the NormalEmail template','body': 'Close Outlook. Win+R → %appdata%\\Microsoft\\Templates → delete NormalEmail.dotm. Outlook recreates a clean one on next launch.'}, {'heading': '2. Clear the signature cache','body': 'File → Options → Mail → Signatures. Delete all signatures, close Outlook, restart, recreate from scratch.'}, {'heading': '3. Force the registry fix for roaming profiles','body': 'Win+R → regedit. Navigate to HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\Software\\Microsoft\\Office\\16.0\\Outlook\\Options\\Mail. Create DWORD: DisableSignatureCache = 1. This stops the sync corruption that eats signatures on managed machines.'}]
whenToCall: ['Signature still vanishes after all three steps — likely a Group Policy or Intune conflict.','You need company-wide signature deployment with images and legal disclaimers.','Mobile/Outlook Web signatures need to match desktop exactly.']
faqs: [{'q': 'Why does my signature work on desktop but not phone?','a': 'Mobile and web signatures are set separately in Outlook → Settings → Mail → Compose and reply. On Mac: Outlook → Preferences → Signatures, delete and recreate. The registry fix doesn\\'t apply.'}]

title: Teams Files Won't Sync? OneDrive Fix in 5 Minutes
excerpt: Red X on files, 'processing changes' forever, or missing folders — the sync reset that works.
symptoms: ['Red X on files in Teams','Files tab says processing changes','Missing folders that exist in SharePoint']
steps: [{'heading': '1. Check the OneDrive sync client, not Teams','body': 'Teams files live in SharePoint/OneDrive. Open the OneDrive tray icon — if it shows errors or paused, that\\'s your real problem. Fix OneDrive and Teams fixes itself.'}, {'heading': '2. Reset the OneDrive sync','body': 'Right-click OneDrive tray → Settings → Account → Unlink this PC. Sign back in, choose the same folders. This rebuilds the local database without touching cloud data.'}, {'heading': '3. Clear the Teams cache','body': 'Fully quit Teams (Ctrl+Shift+Esc → end task). Win+R → %appdata%\\Microsoft\\Teams → delete Cache, Blob_storage, databases, GPUCache, IndexedDB, Local Storage, tmp folders. Relaunch Teams.'}, {'heading': '4. Re-add the SharePoint library','body': 'In Teams, go to the channel → Files → Open in SharePoint → Sync. This creates a fresh OneDrive sync relationship for that library only.'}]
whenToCall: ['Sync works but specific files are corrupt or locked.','You need SharePoint permissions audited — users seeing files they shouldn\\'t.','Migration from Google Drive/Box left broken shortcuts.']
faqs: [{'q': 'Why do files show in SharePoint but not Teams?','a': 'Teams caches the file list. The Files tab is a view of the SharePoint document library — if SharePoint has them, a Teams cache clear (step 3) or library re-sync (step 4) fixes the view.'}, {'q': 'Can I sync just one folder, not the whole library?','a': 'In SharePoint, navigate to the folder → Sync. Only that folder syncs locally. Useful for massive libraries where you only need one project folder.'}, {'q': 'What\\'s the difference between Add Shortcut to OneDrive and Sync?','a': 'Add Shortcut puts a link in your OneDrive file list (web view). title: Windows 11 Start Menu / Search Broken? Reset It in 2 Minutes
excerpt: Start won't open, search shows blank, tiles missing — the PowerShell reset that Microsoft support uses.
symptoms: ['Start menu won\\'t open','Search shows blank or crashes','Missing pinned apps']
steps: [{'heading': '1. Restart Windows Explorer first','body': 'Ctrl+Shift+Esc → Windows Explorer → Restart. This fixes the transient UI glitch about 40% of the time in 5 seconds.'}, {'heading': '2.
